When this city was built, I came here to open\na blacksmith shop, but I thought it was\na total mistake.
Why? Instead of weapons like swords,\nthe orders I got were always magic devices for\nhigh-class wizards.
They require extremely high accuracy of material\nformulation and blacksmithing. So, I kept failing\nat that time. I was thinking of quitting everyday.
Well, thanks to the failures, my skills\nimproved and people trust me now.\nBut, I think I still need to train myself.
Welcome.\nHow can I help you today?
Thanks for coming.\nI look forward to your next visit!

Actually, I was making a living as a synthesist\nin another town until a little while ago.\nIt was a smaller store, though.
It was a small town but I could meet my friends\nany time outside, and people were nice to me. So,\nI wanted to live there for the rest of my life.
But one day, a fierce dragon appeared in the\ntown and it was... Fortunately, Moralo the mayor's\nevacuation call was fast and no one was injured.
The town was burnt down & we got separated but we\ncontinue to keep in touch with one another & plan\nto go back if there's any sign of reconstruction.
Have you heard of the golem masters thing?\nThey are magi who can control golems at will...
What? No no, golem masters are originally from\nthe Resistle. Not the Technista.
Recently, I heard that Technista people were\ninviting golem masters to join them... I don't know\nwhy but they're kinda forcing them...
Technista people don't have a good reputation.\nSo, be careful.
May I have your name, please?\n...Wow, you have an unusual name.\n...Oh, I know. You were born in a faraway country.
My name? My great-grandma gave it to me. Long time\nago, she purified an evil crystal that was causing\ndisasters at sea with Vasaria, the water goddess.
My name, Minette, comes from the name of the\nmermaid princess that eliminated the sadness and\ngrudge in the crystal.
She wants me to become a helpful person just like\nthe princess. I really like the name she gave me.
Hello.\nWhat can I do for you today?
Thanks a lot.\nCome again when you need my help♪

Seems that Jacky looks like a beautiful woman in\nRefalta's eyes...Could it be Jacky's magic?
Anyway, what you have to do now is to know how to\nbreak the enchanted chains.
...Enchanted chains. Hmm... I think they cannot be\ncut with the tools and weapons here.\nEnchanted metals can only be cut with magic.
...What? Well, it would be best to ask the\nsynthesists when it comes to magic,\nbut the magic sounds unusual, so...
You might want to ask [ffff64]Filecia[ffffff].\nShe often deals with strange magic.
